correctness.rationale: For p in (2.9414,2.9415) the Melbourne–Roysdon–Tang–Tkocz source gives A(p)=Gamma(p+1)^(1/p), B(p)=(e/2)M(p)^(1/p) and the unique crossing h=Gamma(p+1)-(e/2)^p M(p)=0 with left/right branch signs. At root, q=J/Gamma obeys q/(1+q)<1/6 using p>2.94 and log2<0.7; log-Gamma convexity gives psi(p+1)<log4<7/5; opposite-monotonicity covariance gives -Jprime/J<1/(p+1)<1/3; log(e/2)>3/10. Differentiating gives hprime/Gamma<-1/90; chain rule yields strict corner Cprime_+−Cprime_->C/(90p)>C/270. Independent 60-digit quadrature gives p0≈2.94147275271262, hprime/Gamma≈-0.1717054, derivative gap≈0.1047084. Numerical check is corroboration; analytic inequalities establish the strict universal statement.
